english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the general means of supporting oneself and staying alive.
Use 生計 as the all-purpose noun for a livelihood or means of financial support.

examples.english: We rely on this plot of land for our subsistence.
examples.traditional: 我哋靠呢塊田維持生計。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 kaau3 ne1 faai3 tin4 wai4 ci4 sang1 gai3

examples.english: They make a living by running a business.
